title: Research: find repeatable high-volatility time windows (session opens, funding times, hour-of-week) per symbol where a short directional trade is predictable net of cost; then strategy, ML and desk branches for the windows that qualify
note: [Manager Session 2026-10-31a, ~11:10Z] OPERATOR ASK 2026-10-31, verbatim excerpt: 'it can also be a strategy ... focused on, say, catching a big breakout at, like, the first half hour or hour of trading, like, find those, like, volatile times in the markets and see if we can get a strategy that does short trades just during those specific times ... We should see if the desk can do that, but also if we can get like a strategy and ML up for something like that as well. So we should do like a scan of some symbols ... It doesn't even need to be opening hours, just where we can find like specific repeatable hours that have a lot of volatility, where we can think we can identify it regularly enough to capitalize on that.' Shape: ONE authoring lane writes a pre-registered stage-A scan unit (runner compute, no Claude cost) plus conditional follow-on nodes (Stage-0 strategy, ML direction head, desk time-window trigger) gated on the scan's verdict. Theme timeframes. Prior art: scripts/backtest_orb.py is fee-only (excluded from any promotion corpus).
